designPolicy.principle: Restrained, elegant, human-art-directed editorial product/news art, not AI-generated ad collage or an infographic.

supportingDetails.description: A few subtle supporting details only where needed; generous whitespace and one visual hierarchy.

typography.headlineAllowed: At most one short, large, correctly typeset 2–5-word heading only if it adds meaning.
typography.captionDuplication: Never repeat the Telegram caption/message or information already clearly expressed in the caption.

designPolicy.onFailure: Regenerate or simplify before publication; do not compromise factual or media-hosting requirements.

mediaHosting.rationale: Adobe-generated preview/share/session HTTPS URLs can return 404 to Zernio; a real raw image file must be hosted and independently validated before publication.
mediaHosting.branchPolicy: Create a unique media/telegram-news-YYYYMMDD-unique branch from the current main SHA for each distinct image. Never alter main, existing files, historical posts, lesson/video code or agent scripts. No duplicate GitHub publishing cron.

fileRequirements.source: Only the newly generated factual news image, not an old/irrelevant placeholder

uploadSteps: Obtain the newly generated image's ACTUAL binary bytes, not an Adobe share/session/preview URL or a markdown image link.

For GitHub Git data API use create_blob with encoding=base64 containing genuine PNG/JPEG bytes; create_tree with the binary blob's SHA and exact file path, create_commit on the isolated media branch, update_ref with the expected branch SHA. A create_file UTF-8 string is NOT a binary image upload.
Build the immutable raw.githubusercontent.com URL from the created image COMMIT SHA and exact path, not a guessed branch URL or a github.com/.../blob HTML page.
Verify remote GET returns HTTP 200, a real image/png or image/jpeg payload with matching dimensions (4:3) and nonzero file size; check Zernio validate_media or validate_post accepts it.
Post only the validated original image plus verified Tajik Cyrillic news text to the exact authorized Telegram account via Zernio, read back published status and deduplicate.
prohibited: Adobe session/share/preview URLs as post media
writing binary content with text-only create_file
altering main branch while archiving media
posting text only when an image was required
mediaHosting.onHostingFailure: Skip public Telegram post, give exact blocker, do not retry publishing without checking Zernio's recent posts first.
mediaHosting.verificationNote: On 2026-10-28 an already committed public PNG in this GitHub repository passed Zernio's read-only validate_media check. This verifies GitHub RAW HOST compatibility only; it does not verify a future agent can acquire generated image bytes, upload them or complete a Telegram post.

output.publication: Automatically publish verified news to Telegram TJ, Instagram RU, Instagram TJ and Facebook TJ as separate image+localized caption Feed posts. No stories/reels/video. No publication without independent media/account checks.

safety.deduplication: Check the prior 72h product-news fingerprint on EACH target independently; do not post duplicates or retry after ambiguous Zernio responses without remote readback.
safety.missingPhotoOrAccount: If no genuine image bytes, immutable public validated media URL or exact active connected social account for a target, skip that target and report blocker; never substitute a video or unrelated image.
safety.readback: Individually verify Zernio post status, target account, language, image URL and link for Telegram, Instagram RU, Instagram TJ and Facebook TJ; report per-account success/skip/failure.
safety.publicationProof: An enabled schedule is not proof of a published Telegram post; verify each actual Zernio post.

copyPolicy.evidence: Read actual HSK-AI-Bot/main HEAD, last 72h commits/diffs and release/deploy evidence; mention only genuinely user-facing launched changes. If no verified news, skip all destinations.

imagePolicy.source: One newly created 4:3 PNG/JPEG factual HSK AI editorial illustration may be shared across all photo/feed destinations only when completely text-free or language-neutral; if it includes readable language-specific text, independently create and validate the language-specific variants.
imagePolicy.designReference: Use existing output.image.designPolicy exactly: 1–2 dominant objects, no tiny repeated text, muted brand-aligned colors and minimal supporting elements.
imagePolicy.hosting: Use existing output.image.mediaHosting; genuine binary file in separate public GitHub media branch, immutable raw.githubusercontent.com commit SHA URL (not Adobe preview), verify HTTP 200, PNG/JPEG bytes, 4:3, and Zernio media validation for each target.
imagePolicy.missingBytes: If generated image bytes or valid HTTPS hosting cannot be obtained, DO NOT publish text-only or substitute unrelated assets; report blocker, do not invent public URL.

deliveryPolicy.preflight: For each of four channels independently verify exact Zernio connection, account ID, username and active status; match canonical account map and correct language. Never use the RU API key for TJ and never route Facebook as RU.
deliveryPolicy.validate: Use each connection's Zernio media validation and content validation, and separately verify post type is Feed photo (not story/reel). Validate format before auto-post.
deliveryPolicy.dedupe: Inspect published and pending posts PER ACCOUNT for the same source product-news fingerprints/commit SHAs. A prior Telegram post must not block a yet-unpublished Instagram photo, and vice versa. NEVER blindly retry ambiguous results.
deliveryPolicy.partialFailure: Process target independently: one failure must not cause reposting to successful targets. Preserve receipts and report which channel succeeded, failed or skipped; retries only for unposted targets after fresh readback.
deliveryPolicy.readback: For every destination verify Zernio returned published status, exact platform and account ID, media image and post URL if available. Do not report success for scheduled/draft/publishing as though posted.
deliveryPolicy.ownerApproval: Owner explicitly authorized these factual static photo-news posts to the specified accounts without per-post approval. Video publishing remains manual and outside this task.
